title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Manga Resumes After 2-Month Hiatus
content: Negi Haruba 's Go! Go! Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga resumed on this year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on Thursday. The manga has been on hiatus since July 8 due to Haruba's health, and was originally announced to resume in August.
author: ANN

title: My Tiny Senpai Manga to End in 14th Volume Next April
content: Saisou confirmed on Monday in a social media reply to a fan that the My Tiny Senpai ( Uchi no Kaisha no Chiisai Sempai no Hanashi or Story of a Small Senior in My Company ) manga will end in the 14th volume next April.

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Part 2 Reveals Main Trailer, Visual, Theme Songs and New Cast
content: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System has revealed a new key visual and main trailer for Part 2, which will continue streaming on Crunchyroll in Fall 2026. Four additional cast members and both theme songs were also announced.

title: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year Game Launches for PC via Steam on November 22
content: Japanese developer Lobstudio announced on Wednesday that its upcoming Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year comedy-mystery adventure game will launch for the PC via Steam on November 22. The game will launch for the Nintendo Switch at a later date.

title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Opens in Malaysia on October 22
content: Muse Asia announced on Saturday that it will open Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, in Malaysia on October 22. The film opened in Japan on July 31.
